jobs.tierReason: local lane probe reads the Keychain key for an opt-in keyed verification
jobs.prompt: Static security review of coordination/review/probefix.diff (tools/local-lane.mjs local lane probe: 401 and 403 now count as reachable-but-auth-required instead of unreachable; an opt-in swarm doctor local --probe-local --verify-key reads the Keychain key at call time and sends it to the configured baseUrl). Promises: the plain probe never sends a key; the keyed verification sends the key only to the configured endpoint baseUrl (never a URL from a manifest, an argument or a redirect), uses redirect error, never prints, logs or records the key or the Authorization header (also in error text and in thrown messages), rejects non-loopback http, reports only a boolean and the HTTP status; 401, 403 and 404 treated as reachable cannot make a dead or hostile endpoint look healthy in a way that sends sensitive jobs somewhere unintended (check the router's sensitive rules for local endpoints: sensitive jobs only on loopback); a probe response body is cancelled and never parsed into output. Verdict PASS or FAIL with ranked findings, no exploit commands.
